purpose: store one exclusive module-port-role owner for every local data bank
semantics: owner_port identifies a module port role and never an opcode or whole module
all asserted acquire_valid entries form one atomic request
if any requested bank is busy or both acquired and released in one cycle then no acquire entry commits
all asserted release_valid entries form one atomic request
if any released bank is free or release_port does not match bank_owner_port then no release entry commits
valid matching releases and a disjoint valid acquire may commit in the same cycle
reset clears all busy bits owners and error state

required_cases: bank zero acquire and matching release
three-bank atomic GEMM acquire maps src0 activation src1 weight and dst psum
one busy operand rejects the entire three-bank acquire
mismatching owner release rejects the entire release and preserves state
same-bank acquire and release overlap faults without state change
two different banks may have the same module-port-role owner
